name: Icefall
description: An orange dwarf with twin frozen worlds, a dwarf companion, and a broad icy belt. Waterfalls of cryovolcanic ice give the system its name. Everything runs cold, slow, and well documented.

stars.name: Icefall Glow
stars.description: A steady orange dwarf with a calm output the cold worlds depend on. Its light is thin but utterly reliable. The ice would not survive a livelier star.

planets.name: Firstfall
planets.description: A nitrogen-glacier world with cryovolcanic falls freezing mid-plunge. Geysers erupt along the terminator in seasonal choirs. The ice here is mined for export, not water.

planets.name: Secondfall
planets.description: A second ice world with a thicker sky and slower, grander falls. Methane snow drifts in dunes across the plains. Its night side hosts the system's coldest recorded temperature.

dwarfPlanets.name: Fallstone
dwarfPlanets.description: A small ice dwarf keeping the outer count beyond the belt. Its frost plains record every era of bombardment. Chronologists prize its undisturbed strata.

belts.name: Falls Kuiper
belts.description: A broad icy belt feeding the cryovolcanoes with slow infall. Cold classicals preserve formation chemistry in deep freeze. Sample returns write their own proposals.
